checks.name: verbatim Unicode, projected host identity, clone isolation and a separate process reopen
create replay never resamples or replaces original evidence; operation conflicts reject
phase, runtime readiness, missing identity and each identity transition fail closed
untrusted parameters, invalid encoding, paths and unsupported operations are rejected
world isolation, pagination, durable deletion and replay cannot resurrect a deleted record
write, sync and rename failures preserve exact old ledger; errors do not disclose paths
response loss after atomic commit resolves from the original receipt
real process interruption before and after rename recovers without partial records
bounded concurrent requests and multiple same-process factories never lose updates
capture timeout is bounded and a late callback cannot create a record
active-record quota blocks growth and deletion permits a new record
cumulative receipt capacity preserves deletion and old retries without recycling
serialized-byte quota rejects growth before the active-record limit
failed delete preserves the record and a lost delete response remains recoverable
corrupt or oversized ledger is never replaced with an empty success
hardlink and ancestor junction/symlink are refused without modifying the sentinel
